# Apple Education Community

> A collaborative hub for educators to connect, learn, and share teaching resources powered by Apple's educational technologies and professional learning programs.

The Apple Education Community provides educators with access to professional learning opportunities, peer collaboration forums, and resources for integrating Apple technologies like iPad and Mac into classroom instruction. The platform emphasizes teacher empowerment through programs like Apple Teacher and challenge-based learning methodologies.

## Key Topics

- Apple Teacher
- Professional Learning
- Educator Collaboration
- Challenge Based Learning
- iPad
- Mac
- Teaching with Technology
- Everyone Can Create
- Lesson Integration
- Teacher Resources
- Learning Center
- Managed Apple Account
- Community Forum
- Creative Projects
- Foundational Skills

## Community Hub

- [Education Community](https://education.apple.com): Apple Education Community hub for educators to learn, collaborate, and connect.
- [Forum](https://education.apple.com/forum): Community forum for educators to share resources and collaborate on teaching.

## Support & Resources

- [Get Help](https://education.apple.com/get-help): FAQ and troubleshooting for Apple Education Community account access.
- [Forum Help](https://education.apple.com/forum/forum-help-resources): Guide for using the Apple Education Community forum and user profiles.

## Optional

- [Logout](https://education.apple.com/logout): Logout page for Apple Education Community user sessions.
